inspection_scope: Rough production b01–b12, assessed from supplied ordered sheets, native 360×640 images and every intermediate frame in the supplied consecutive event strips, in both caption modes. Compared behavior with audiobook, basement-completion and recording gold. Complete-film progression assessed within these sampling limits.

gates.evidence: Opening Bot has a readable surprised silhouette; naming changes to a quieter listening posture. Bot is explicitly absent thereafter.
App connectors do not meet the depicted socket mouths; the permission slip never reaches its stop; the folded answer pedestal remains detached from the work surface.
Opening, future-status and access-comparison passages contain completed or undeveloped pictures held under changing captions. Pixel changes do not establish purposeful development.
Notched token, scalloped cloud base, cut-paper icons, layered folio and human-held key retain distinctive silhouettes and a coherent tactile material language.
The obsolete chat silhouette persists behind the connected network and cloud computer without contributing a readable continuing relationship.
Several essential propositions depend on captions or local labels rather than their declared physical action. Socket seams, pedestal landing and final withheld-key gap are inadequately exposed.

violations.observation: Frames 0, 21, 41 and 62 retain the same edge-on station, hovering token and already-surprised Bot. The introduction has no readable developing action until the later station reveal.
violations.smallest_correction: Begin the station unfolding during the introduction and tie Bot's surprise to that visible change.

violations.observation: The day marker remains a sun through the final supplied frame. Changing display bars do not communicate work continuing across day and night without the caption.
violations.smallest_correction: Show the time marker change while the same identifiable assignment visibly advances.

violations.observation: Across frames 250–262 the envelope connector terminates at the card's upper edge while the depicted socket is below the card. The teal plug travels across the card toward the lower socket separately. Frames 258–268 repeat this mismatch for the folder and calendar: routes reach card edges while plugs arrive at different anchors.
violations.smallest_correction: Route each connector endpoint and its plug to the same visible socket mouth; maintain that attachment throughout approach, compression and recovery.

violations.observation: The connection confirmation is a tiny teal change in the lower dots, spatially separated from the cable endpoints. A quick native-size glance shows a network but cannot read the promised seated seams.
violations.smallest_correction: Expose larger socket lips at the actual route endpoints and let their local compression carry confirmation.

violations.observation: The pale closed chat-bubble shape remains behind the new computer and cable junction. It no longer explains containment or the computing seat and adds an obsolete layer to the current proposition.
violations.smallest_correction: Remove the chat enclosure once its boundary has been left, retaining only the connected apps and independent shelf.

violations.observation: The DRAFT sheet is already emerging in frames 371–374 while the incoming teal sheet has not yet reached the final stop at frame 377. The output's appearance precedes the visible completion that should produce it.
violations.smallest_correction: Keep the draft exit empty until the final sheet seats and clears; then reveal the draft as the local consequence.

violations.observation: Teal slips traverse the diagonal icon chain, but the accordion does not visibly compress and the cropped coral page does not establish a person's continuing separate activity. The caption supplies the background-work relationship.
violations.smallest_correction: Show completed folds compressing and a recognizable foreground user sheet actively turning while the assignment continues behind it.

violations.observation: The specialist workflow is shown exposed behind a PREVIEW heading. Its translucent restriction appears only when the team layer arrives. The label therefore supplies the initial preview qualification instead of reinforcing a visible boundary.
violations.smallest_correction: Keep a visibly separate vellum veil over the specialist workflow from its first reveal.

violations.observation: After the team card lands, frames 548, 549, 563, 578 and 593 show the same completed status arrangement while captions continue. No further inspection, unfolding or consequential development is visible.
violations.smallest_correction: Spread the unopened fold's reveal across the remaining sentence, ending with the empty slots and closed boundary becoming legible.

violations.observation: Every frame 664–676 leaves the envelope slip separated from the shutter by a visible air gap. The declared impact never occurs; the shutter changes locally while the slip remains away from its stop.
violations.smallest_correction: Bring the slip's leading corner to the shutter edge, stop it there and apply the bounded response to that contact.

violations.observation: Without captions, the picture is a locked barrier, key and floating envelope. It does not show a proposed action reaching execution and being retained pending approval.
violations.smallest_correction: Make the approach, contact and retained pending slip the central readable action; preserve the human-held key as subordinate.

violations.observation: The eligible-paid-plan sign arrives above a barred entrance, but no required ticket and ticket-shaped receiving slot are exposed. The commercial condition is introduced by wording rather than the declared ticket-dependent geometry.
violations.smallest_correction: Expose the required slot and retain a matching eligibility ticket outside it before introducing the explanatory sign.

violations.observation: The barred Dots entrance and closed Muse entrance remain the same completed arrangement through the eligible-plan caption passage. The token's negligible residual changes do not develop eligibility or prepare the comparison.
violations.smallest_correction: Use this interval to develop the ticket requirement and overlap the preparation of the Muse cover opening.

violations.observation: The final comparison reads as blocked versus open entrances, but paid versus free access comes from the signs. The required-ticket action is absent, so the declared access distinction is not physically demonstrated.
violations.smallest_correction: Make ticket-required versus unobstructed entry visibly different before using signs to identify the terms.

violations.observation: Throughout frames 941–953 the flattened answer pedestal hovers above and left of the desk. It never joins or lands into the shared edge, despite this being the declared landing window.
violations.smallest_correction: Keep the pedestal attached to a visible hinge and finish its fold at the work-surface edge.

violations.observation: The former question-and-answer object shrinks to a small floating blue strip. Its identity and hinge relationship cannot be read at 360×640 during the essential reframing.
violations.smallest_correction: Retain a readable question-and-answer silhouette through the fold and frame its landing into the broader plane.

violations.observation: Caption-free evidence shows the answer card disappearing into a tiny detached strip and a desk appearing below. It does not communicate the narrow exchange becoming part of a broader working relationship.
violations.smallest_correction: Show one continuous attached silhouette transforming from pedestal into the desk edge.

violations.observation: Frames 1073–1085 retain the hand/key grip and closed lock, but the key tip nearly meets the lock outline. The essential withheld gap is only a few native pixels and does not clearly distinguish stopping short from insertion.
violations.smallest_correction: Stop the key farther from the lock and expose a plainly visible background gap throughout the final hold.

sampling_limits: No tools, MP4 playback or listening used. Sparse ordered frames establish broad before/after states; consecutive strips establish only their bounded event intervals. All intermediate supplied strip frames were inspected in labeled order in both caption modes. Pixel traces were treated as change observations, not proof of contact or purposeful motion. Continuous hinge motion, unprovided event intervals and exact material deformation remain unassessed where pictures do not establish them. The supplied output schema supports six visual gates; story, cause-effect and continuity findings are incorporated into their relevant visual gates and evidence.
